dataset_metadata.name: Oxford Battery Degradation Dataset 1
dataset_metadata.citation: Birkl, C.R., 'Diagnosis and Prognosis of Degradation in Lithium-Ion Batteries', PhD thesis, University of Oxford, 2017. DOI: 10.5287/bodleian:KO2kdmYGg

cell_info.cell_notes: Kokam CO LTD SLPB533459H4, 740 mAh lithium-ion pouch cell

aging_modes.notes: All 8 cells tested under identical conditions (same temperature, charge and discharge protocol)

time_protocol.test_equipment: Bio-Logic MPG-205, 8 channel; Binder thermal chamber
time_protocol.notes: Data collected from 2015-01-08 to 2016-12-31. Total number of drive cycles not explicitly stated.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Main file (253.8 MB) contains characterization data only. ExampleDC_C1.mat (70.9 KB) contains raw V/I/T timeseries for the first drive cycle only.
rawdata.known_issues: Full per-cycle raw timeseries for all cycling is not available; only the first cycle is provided as an example.

checkup.notes: Characterization every 100 drive cycles. Includes 1C charge/discharge cycles and pseudo-OCV cycles (at 40 mA = ~C/18.5). Variables recorded: time, voltage, charge, temperature.

notes: The dataset is primarily a checkup/characterization dataset. The main .mat file contains hierarchical data: Layer 1 = cells (1-8), Layer 2 = cycle number (e.g. cyc0100), Layer 3 = 1C charge (C1ch), 1C discharge (C1dc), pseudo-OCV charge (OCVch), pseudo-OCV discharge (OCVdc), Layer 4 = t, v, q, T. License is ODC Open Database License (ODbL); no direct SPDX identifier in controlled vocabulary, mapped to 'unknown'. Charge rate of 2C stated in ExampleDC_C1.mat description; checkup uses 1C. Voltage cycling range not stated in available documents.
